title: Mod Settings Manager sidecar, format 1
description: Optional labels, sections, ranges and options for one plugin's config file. Ship it as Settings/<Group>_<Name>.settings.json in the plugin jar or next to the config file. Mod Settings Manager reads it; nothing else does, so it costs a mod no dependency. MIT licensed: any mod may ship a sidecar freely.

format.description: Sidecar format version. This schema describes format 1.

plugin.description: The plugin this sidecar describes, as Group:Name from its manifest.json.

title.description: Optional. The mod's display name for people, for example "Calendar & Seasons". Shown in the settings window and in chat instead of the manifest Name. Mod Settings Manager 1.0.0 rejects a sidecar that has this field.

config.description: Path of the config file relative to the plugin's data folder. Defaults to config.json.

sections.description: Groups of keys, shown in this order.

keys.description: Per-key settings. A key may be dotted ("Seeder.CellSize") to address a nested object. Keys of the config not listed here still show up, with a control inferred from their value.

label.description: Shown instead of the key name.

section.description: The id of a section in sections.

type.description: The control to show. Without it, the type is inferred from the value in the config.

options.description: The allowed values, shown as a dropdown. Implies type enum.

default.description: The value Reset to default restores.

restart.description: true: the change takes effect only after a restart. false: the mod picks it up live.

hidden.description: true: never shown in the window.
